title: OpenStreetMap tags
publisher: OpenStreetMap community (tag definitions: OpenStreetMap wiki); colours: OpenStreetMap Carto
version: OSM wiki and taginfo as of 2026-09-30; OpenStreetMap Carto v6.1.0 (2026-09-10)
colour_source: https://github.com/openstreetmap-carto/openstreetmap-carto/tree/master/style (landcover.mss, style.mss, water.mss, water-features.mss, buildings.mss, roads.mss, road-colors-generated.mss)
license_note: Tag keys and values are facts from the OSM wiki key pages (landuse, natural, wetland, water, leisure, landcover, surface, barrier, waterway, man_made, amenity, highway, building, roof:material, green_roof, leaf_type, denotation, garden:type) and taginfo. Colours are the OSM Carto v6.1.0 fill colours, given only where the style files define a plain hex for that tag.
note: Records are OSM tag dicts (osmnx columns). An entry with two tags beats every single-tag entry; among equals the first in the file wins. File order: (1) two-tag combinations that change the drawing (green roofs, building footprints over use tags, wetland/water/leaf-type/meadow/basin/garden sub-types, pitch surfaces, paving material, earth and grass surfaces on highways); (2) single tags: surface (material beats function), landcover, natural, wetland, water, landuse (cover values), leisure, tourism, amenity, highway, man_made, barrier, waterway, zone-type landuse/amenity (residential, retail, school …), roof, building (building=* last). Semicolon lists such as surface=ground;grass are not split; split them first. Unlisted values (surface=hard, mixed …) fall through to the next tag of the object. barrier=*, waterway=*, natural=tree_row are lines; natural=tree, amenity=bench, highway=street_lamp are points.

entries.name: building=* + green_roof=yes
entries.note: Wiki (Key:green_roof): green roofs appear as roof:material=grass, plants, gravel (sedum) or roof_greening; gravel alone is not enough. No extensive/intensive values exist, so drawn as extensive (nearest).

entries.name: building=* + roof:material=grass
entries.note: Wiki: roof covered with living grass (or similar plants), sealed below. Wiki (Key:green_roof): green roofs appear as roof:material=grass, plants, gravel (sedum) or roof_greening; gravel alone is not enough. No extensive/intensive values exist, so drawn as extensive (nearest).
